meta.title: Muthukrishnan (Muthu) Bommiah | Governed Enterprise AI in Financial Services
meta.description: Muthukrishnan (Muthu) Bommiah is a Distinguished Engineer at Wells Fargo who builds governed Generative and agentic AI for regulated enterprises: AI strategy, AI-augmented software delivery, Architecture-as-Code and production ML at scale.
meta.disclosure: Views are my own and do not represent my employer.

personal.name: Muthukrishnan Bommiah
personal.title: Distinguished Engineer, Wells Fargo
personal.tagline: Governed AI for regulated enterprises: guardrails, provenance and policy by design.

about.bio: I help regulated enterprises put AI to work safely and at scale. As a Distinguished Engineer at Wells Fargo, I advise technology leadership on enterprise Generative and agentic AI, co-authored the CTO's AI strategy, and led the AI-Augmented SDLC transformation that lifted productivity 30% across 25,000 developers. Before that, at USAA, I built the enterprise machine learning platform that brought 360 data scientists onto one governed environment, in partnership with Model Risk Management. My point of view: guardrails, provenance and policy belong in the design, not bolted on afterwards.
focus: Enterprise strategy and architecture for Generative and agentic AI: AI gateways, agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and banking-grade risk guardrails.
AI-native software delivery: bringing coding agents into the SDLC with context, maker/checker controls, provenance and measured productivity.
Governance as code: Architecture-as-Code and policy-as-code that check designs automatically before anything reaches production.

experience.title: Distinguished Engineer
experience.company: Wells Fargo · Chief Technology Office, Enterprise Architecture
experience.description: Strategic advisor to the Technology Leadership Team on enterprise Generative and agentic AI across Chief Technology Office platforms and the software development lifecycle: AI gateways, agent frameworks and lifecycle, Model Context Protocol (MCP) and banking-specific risk guardrails. Represents the CTO at the Chief Architect and GenAI Architecture forums. Distinguished Engineers are fewer than 0.1% of the bank's engineers.
achievements: Led the AI-Augmented SDLC transformation with the Chief Development Officer, integrating coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Cognition Devin, Anthropic Claude, Cursor) with a bank-built context layer and a unified AI gateway with maker/checker controls, delivering a 30% productivity gain across 25,000 developers.
Co-authored the CTO's enterprise AI strategy; serving as chief architect for Data & AI since 2023, enabled 20+ business AI use cases.
Architecture approver within Enterprise Architecture for Generative AI products, and a stakeholder on the AI Architecture Review Board that reviews every GenAI and agentic use case at the bank.
Created and led architecture review boards for the CTO, driving architecture decisions that span multiple lines of business.

Built an Architecture-as-Code control plane with the Chief Architects (automated guardrails plus permit-to-build and permit-to-operate checks) adopted across 4,500+ applications, cutting architecture review time 50%.
Leads the managers of 8 teams in a 90-person virtual organization across 4 lines of business, setting architecture, standards and priorities for enterprise AI, data and cloud platforms.

experience.title: Principal Architect
experience.description: Multi-cloud (GCP, Azure) Data & AI architecture for the Chief Technology Office: the bank's principal cloud data architect and trusted architect for AI/ML initiatives. In 2023, enterprise and data architect for Customer Analytics, mentoring a team of architects.
achievements: Designed and deployed the bank's first enterprise Generative AI architecture, endorsed by the Cloud Architecture Panel and presented to the CTO and CIO; adopted as the reference model across business lines.

Took the bank's first Generative AI use case live in September 2024: a retrieval-augmented assistant giving bankers real-time policy guidance, piloted with 5,000 bankers, with guardrails against prompt injection and data leakage.
Served as chief architect for Data & AI on public cloud (2024), enabling Gemini models, the Vertex AI platform and the model development lifecycle for predictive and generative models on GCP.
Led the Teradata-to-BigQuery modernization, cutting infrastructure costs 35%, and delivered the bank's first BigQuery application with confidential data.
Architected the customer analytics platform behind a consumer lending launch that generated more than 10 million unique offers in its first week.
Defined the multi-cloud Data & AI strategy and reusable cloud data and AI archetypes that enabled 14 GCP services; trained the CTO and CTO direct reports on LLMs, agentic AI and responsible AI.

experience.title: Staff Engineer, Data & Analytics Platform
experience.description: Led data and machine learning platform engineering for USAA's Data & Analytics Platform as lead of leads across 4 agile teams, and served as technical advisor to the Enterprise Model Risk Management Committee.
achievements: Architected a configuration-driven controlled data movement platform processing 25B+ records and 800K files per day into AWS and Snowflake, with automated lineage and sensitive-data protection.
Delivered its next generation with 20x scalability, 10x lower latency, a 0.01% exception rate and a 99.9% SLO.
Wrote and gave final approval on AWS architecture specifications for identity, data protection, infrastructure security and detective controls for the cloud data platform.
Helped create USAA's first-line model risk operating model with the Modeling Center of Excellence and the Enterprise Model Risk Management Committee.

experience.title: Lead Software Engineer, Data & Analytics Platform
experience.description: Built USAA's enterprise machine learning platform and model deployment pipelines, used by data scientists, data engineers and the Model Risk Management team.
achievements: Consolidated 360 data scientists and modeling analysts onto a single governed ML platform, saving $25M in license costs over 3 years; Risk used the platform for independent model validation.
Cut model deployment time from 8 weeks to 5 days with CI/CD pipelines for on-demand, batch, event-driven and retraining workloads; introduced Apache Airflow at USAA.
Scaled real-time scoring for 5 cyber financial-crime models to 24M+ scores per day at under 500 ms.
Built a one-click Model Deploy Console with audit traceability, used for 45+ models across 5 business units; 22 models reached production in 6 months across 3 lines of business.

Presented AI and platform strategies to USAA's CTO, CEO and Chairman of the Board.
Built USAA's first Oracle Identity Federation servers and the access-management foundation (SSO, MFA, authorization) for later Okta and Salesforce integrations.
